verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since an email provider could offer shared team inboxes, but the evidence never documents shared inboxes, team seats or channels where several human teammates see the same conversation state. What it does show is adjacent: IMAP/SMTP client access to an inbox, organization-wide thread listing, labels for tracking conversation state, and cc'ing humans. These are building blocks or related features, not a shared-inbox collaboration capability.

support.subject: As a team-lead, my team works shared inboxes together — shared accounts or team channels where everyone sees the same conversation state
